description: firmware provider: Zephyr board definitions for nRF52840 modules (devicetree with pinctrl, buses, devices, buttons, display; Kconfig), every setting citing the UHD facts it comes from.

skills.summary: SOP: configure Zephyr for a UHD board with an nRF52840 module (firmware capability): config, generate, check, export, build hand-off; every setting cited

capabilities.summary: Zephyr 4.2 board definition (board.yml, Kconfig, defconfig, devicetree, pinctrl) and a Kconfig fragment for an nRF52840 board

generate.summary: Read the board into a firmware map, apply the rules, write the board definition and firmware.conf under zephyr/ with the line index

export.summary: Copy the generated files to out/config/ and write out/firmware.manifest.json (refuses files edited since generate)

extract.summary: Artifact references and the pins the devicetree names

check.summary: Pin table, single use, bus functions, I2C addresses, strapping, wake sources, devicetree structure, and drift between the files and the board

controller.description: instance path of the controller, when the board has more than one microcontroller

board_name.description: Zephyr board name (default: the module id with _ for -)

vendor.description: board vendor folder and compatible prefix (default protoboard)

console.description: UART bus id or UART device instance for zephyr,console

i2c_frequency_hz.description: I2C bus clock: 100000 or 400000 (default: the fastest every device allows)

uart_baud.description: { <instance>: baud } for UART devices that state no baud_rate

wake.description: [<button or device instance | net>] inputs that wake the chip from System OFF (written as zephyr,user wakeup-gpios)

properties.description: { <instance>: { <devicetree property>: value } } for what a driver binding requires and the model does not state
